content.text: In a peer-mediated revision study, paper ratings improved by a mean of 1.1 points out of 7 between drafts (t(11) = 6.51, p < 0.001, Cohen's d = 1.62), which the authors interpret as meaningful improvement following feedback-driven revision (Li & Hebert, 2023). Notably, participants acted on both higher-order content and low-level language issues, contrary to earlier findings that students make only low-level revisions on second drafts (Li & Hebert, 2023). The authors state that a causal role for students' self-reflections was not established (Li & Hebert, 2023).
